content:
{
  "findings": [
    {
      "title": "Primary endpoint analysis not specified",
      "quote": "The primary endpoint of Study 20190009 is progression-free Survival (PFS).",
      "page": 38,
      "section": "2.1.2 Primary Endpoints",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "critical",
      "explanation": "The primary endpoint is defined but no statistical analysis method (e.g., Kaplan-Meier, Cox model) is stated in this section or in the extracted stats facts. The protocol must specify the analysis for the primary endpoint.",
      "fix": "Add a description of the primary analysis method for PFS, including the statistical model and how the hazard ratio will be estimated."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing estimand attributes for primary endpoint",
      "quote": "Estimand framework will be utilized to align the clinical trial design and analysis with the endpoints of interest while accounting for any intercurrent events.",
      "page": 38,
      "section": "2.1.2 Primary Endpoints",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The text mentions the estimand framework but does not provide the full set of estimand attributes (population, variable, intercurrent events, summary measure) in this section. The attributes are only partially given in Section 3, but the primary estimand description lacks a clear summary measure (HR is mentioned but not the analysis model).",
      "fix": "Provide a complete estimand specification for the primary endpoint, including all attributes and the summary measure with the analysis method."
    },
    {
      "title": "Key secondary endpoints lack analysis methods",
      "quote": "The key secondary endpoints are OS, objective response rate (ORR), patient-reported outcomes (PRO), including change from baseline (cycle 1 day 1) over time to week 12 in disease related symptoms (dyspnea, cough, and chest pain), physical functioning, and health related quality of life (QOL).",
      "page": 38,
      "section": "2.1.3 Key Secondary Endpoints",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The key secondary endpoints are listed but no statistical analysis methods are described for them in this section. The protocol should specify how each endpoint will be analyzed (e.g., Cox model for OS, logistic regression for ORR, mixed model for PRO).",
      "fix": "Add a statistical analysis section for each key secondary endpoint, including the model, covariates, and handling of missing data."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing handling of missing data for PRO endpoints",
      "quote": "Change from baseline over time to week 12 in physical functioning and global health status will also be compared in subjects receiving AMG 510 compared to docetaxel, to allow assessment of possible impact on health related QOL.",
      "page": 38,
      "section": "2.1.3 Key Secondary Endpoints",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The PRO endpoints are defined, but there is no description of how missing PRO data will be handled (e.g., multiple imputation, mixed model repeated measures). This is a common gap in oncology trials.",
      "fix": "Specify the missing data handling strategy for PRO endpoints, including sensitivity analyses."
    },
    {
      "title": "Inconsistent intercurrent event strategy for PFS",
      "quote": "PFS is censored at the date of last evaluable assessment before or on start of new anti-cancer therapy.",
      "page": 48,
      "section": "3 Objectives and Endpoints",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The estimand for PFS uses a treatment policy strategy? Actually, it censors at start of new therapy, which is a hypothetical strategy, but the description says 'before or on start of new anti-cancer therapy' which is ambiguous. Also, the primary estimand description says 'before or on start of new anti-cancer therapy' but the strategy is not clearly labeled. This could lead to inconsistent implementation.",
      "fix": "Clarify the intercurrent event strategy for PFS (e.g., treatment policy vs. hypothetical) and ensure the estimand description matches the strategy."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing sample size and power inputs",
      "quote": "The primary endpoint of Study 20190009 is progression-free Survival (PFS).",
      "page": 38,
      "section": "2.1.2 Primary Endpoints",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "critical",
      "explanation": "The extracted stats facts show no sample size, alpha, power, effect size, or dropout rate. The protocol must include a sample size section with these inputs to justify the trial size.",
      "fix": "Add a sample size section that specifies the assumed control PFS rate, hazard ratio, alpha, power, and dropout rate."
    },
    {
      "title": "Multiplicity not addressed for key secondary endpoints",
      "quote": "The key secondary endpoints are OS, objective response rate (ORR), patient-reported outcomes (PRO), including change from baseline (cycle 1 day 1) over time to week 12 in disease related symptoms (dyspnea, cough, and chest pain), physical functioning, and health related quality of life (QOL).",
      "page": 38,
      "section": "2.1.3 Key Secondary Endpoints",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "There are multiple key secondary endpoints, but no mention of how multiplicity will be controlled (e.g., hierarchical testing, alpha allocation). This is a critical gap for confirmatory trials.",
      "fix": "Describe the multiplicity control strategy for key secondary endpoints, such as a hierarchical testing procedure."
    },
    {
      "title": "PRO estimand summary measure not fully specified",
      "quote": "Change from baseline to Week 12 in PRO endpoints between AMG 510 and docetaxel, for subjects with previously treated locally advanced and unresectable or metastatic NSCLC with KRAS p.G12C mutation.",
      "page": 48,
      "section": "3 Objectives and Endpoints",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "The PRO estimand description mentions 'change from baseline to Week 12' but does not specify the summary measure (e.g., mean difference, difference in change scores) or the analysis model (e.g., mixed model repeated measures).",
      "fix": "Specify the summary measure and statistical model for the PRO estimand."
    }
  ]
}
